title: Crystalline and amorphous solids
caption: A crystalline solid such as quartz has its particles in a regular, repeating arrangement and a sharp melting point. An amorphous solid such as glass has the same close packing but no long-range order, and softens over a range of temperatures.
alt: Two boxes of the same particles: a regular grid (crystalline) and a disordered close packing (amorphous).
description: Amorphous: just as close together, but disordered.
